notes:
﻿Patch 0.1.18 (auto-patch) — recovery

If 0.1.17 left the game frozen after restart: close Manafall in Task Manager, then let this update apply (or run the website apply script / reinstall from Download).

0.1.17 mixed an older Manafall.exe with newer script DLLs. This build matches the player and scripts again.

Also includes everything from 0.1.17:

Loot and chests
- Ground loot fills the hotbar first when there is room.
- Chest UI: Take All (R) and Put All (T); Shift-click quick-moves; opening loot opens your bag.
- Low-end / high-end chests roll the right weapon and armor tiers.

Creatures
- Creatures can hurt each other again.
- Heavy fast impacts can hurt you.
- Ride bug height sync and a bit higher stand pose.

Controls and death
- Inventory mouse stays unlocked while the bag is open.
- Death camera stays on your corpse.
- Host HUD shows public Join list status.

Online / menu / patching
- Shared public Join list advertising.
- Host and client keep the same time of day.
- Main menu no longer draws terrain trees.
- Near tree leaves take fog like far cards.
- Multi-part patch join/hash does not freeze the menu.
- Clearer message when an update file is missing (not raw HTTP 404).
